page.content:
Next Avatar — waterbender of the South in the sibling series.

How Korra connects

  • Series: The Legend of Korra — The Legend of Korra is Korra's story as the next Avatar.
  • Faction: Water Tribes — Korra is born to the Southern Water Tribe.
  • Concept: Avatar cycle — Korra is the Avatar after Aang.

What is Korra?

Korra is the Avatar after Aang, a Southern Water Tribe prodigy who must learn airbending and a modern world's politics in The Legend of Korra.

Key threads lead to The Legend of Korra, Water Tribes and Avatar cycle.
